mapper.select: SELECT *, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, pwd_change_dtt, now()) as pwd_age, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, last_login, now()) as login_age from t_manager where id = #{ id };
mapper.update: UPDATE t_manager SET status = 1, quit_dtt = null, quit_reason = null WHERE id = #{ 0 }
UPDATE t_manager SET wrong_count = 0, last_login = now() WHERE id = #{ 0 }
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_manager (id, name, pwd, reg_dtt, pwd_change_dtt, roles) VALUE (#{ id }, #{ name }, #{ pwd }, now(), now(), #{ roles });
mapper.update: UPDATE t_manager SET wrong_count = wrong_count + 1 WHERE id = #{ id }
UPDATE t_manager SET wrong_count = 0, last_login = now() WHERE id = #{ id }
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM t_login_history r LEFT JOIN t_manager ON r.actor = t_manager.id
